newsitem.title: USA: Donna Karan Int'l to search for co-CEO.
newsitem.headline: Donna Karan Int'l to search for co-CEO.

text.p: Donna Karan International Inc on Thursday said it was searching for a co-chief executive officer that would focus on strategic planning and finance.

Donna Karan, chairman, chief executive and founder of the fashion design company, said in a statement: "I initiated this search because I must be free to realize the company's potential, I must be free to focus all my energies on design and fashion, and that Steve Ruzow must be able to concentrate on day-to-day operations of the company."
Ruzow is the company's president and chief operating officer.
